Runtime-dispatched SIMD for image decoding (see plans/08-simd-acceleration.md).

Contract: every dispatched path is bit-identical to its scalar oracle. x86_64 uses SSE2 always (ABI baseline) and AVX2 when runtimecheck reports it; arm64 uses NEON. Unknown PNG filters return false so callers can raise bad filter. Small PNG rows (< 16 bytes) stay scalar to avoid setup cost.

FP-contract note: ARM64 always has FMA, so without this flag Clang/GCC fuse scalar a*b+c into one rounding while the NEON/SSE/AVX intrinsics below stay two roundings (off-by-one after int truncation). Disabled so oracle and kernels round identically on all arches.

simd/x86_sse2, simd/x86_avx2

useNeon = false
